title: Automatic metric update setting
description: A user-controlled preference that enables or disables automatic updates for one fitness metric.

metricType.description: The stable fitness metric identifier controlled by this setting.

enabled.description: Whether automatic updates are enabled for this metric.

createdAt.description: The time the setting was created in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: The time the setting was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
